files.description: Seven hand-written Playwright tests for service creation, mocked generation and persisted Overview, builder feedback/permissions, fake-Flickr OAuth and live-read testing, and separate republish, sync-consent, and deletion flows.

testContext: Custom services are created from the New automation modal. The serial suite uses the isolated seed and fake Flickr origin overrides. Generation progress/status are mocked in separate chat and generated-adapter tests; the latter persists the checked-in Flickr adapter fixture before the completion reload and verifies the Overview plus its absence from Send to… while still a draft. The OAuth scenario saves credentials, approves OAuth, answers live-read permission, reviews/publishes endpoints, and runs Test. Provider counters are checked relative to the start of each attempt. A separate republish scenario creates its own service and signed-in account, then creates a Send sync. A fixture helper seeds prior consent to verify wider access revokes consent and protects deletion until the sync is removed. Each scenario inherits the 30-second timeout, and the republish scenario cleans its sync before its service even on failure.
explanation: Hand-written from specs/sync_services.yaml and the service template/routes. The generation test mocks asynchronous model work but persists a statically checked fixture adapter to exercise the real rendered Overview. Provider behavior runs against scripts/fake_flickr.py with the checked-in Flickr target adapter.
